I removed the 50 Hz mains hum from `ecg_50hz_hum` using a notch filter with a quality factor of 30, designed for the 500 Hz sample rate. With zero-phase filtering applied twice, the total attenuation at the 50 Hz cutoff reached -568.55 dB. 

Comparing the spectra before and after filtering, the probe at 50 Hz showed a drop from -12 dB down to -104 dB (a difference of -92 dB), successfully eliminating the interference while preserving the underlying ECG signal. The RMS decreased from 0.293 to 0.2336.
